gloss: person who likes alcohol; fond of drinking

definitions.gloss: person who likes alcohol; fond of drinking
definitions.explanation: Someone who enjoys drinking alcoholic beverages. Can describe either the person or the quality of being fond of alcohol.

examples.japanese: {酒好|さけず}きの{友人|ゆうじん}と{居酒屋|いざかや}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an izakaya with a friend who loves drinking.

examples.japanese: {酒好|さけず}きにはたまらない{品揃|しなぞろ}えのバーだ。
examples.english: It's a bar with an irresistible selection for alcohol lovers.

notes:
Composed of {酒|さけ} (alcohol, sake) and {好|す}き (liking, fond of). The {好|す}き becomes {好|ず}き (voiced) in this compound due to rendaku. A casual, everyday word with no negative connotation — it simply means someone enjoys alcohol, unlike {大酒飲|おおざけの}み or アルコール{依存症|いぞんしょう}, which imply excess.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒好|さけず}きな{人|ひと}: a person who likes drinking
- {酒好|さけず}きにはたまらない: irresistible for alcohol lovers
- {酒好|さけず}きが{集|あつ}まる: alcohol lovers gather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}ん{兵衛|べえ}: heavy drinker — colloquial and somewhat humorous
- {左党|さとう}: drinker, sake lover — literary/humorous synonym
- {甘党|あまとう}: person with a sweet tooth — the opposite pairing, preferring sweets over alcohol

RELATED PATTERN:
The ~{好|ず}き pattern is productive: {甘|あま}い{物|もの}{好|ず}き (sweet tooth), {猫|ねこ}{好|ず}き (cat lover), {映画|えいが}{好|ず}き (movie lover).
